reproduction.method: Use an isolated copy of the pinned source with the exact four test files. Execute the baseline once, then apply exactly one listed replacement at a time, execute the same 75 tests and restore the original source before the next mutant.
reproduction.killRequirement: Baseline exit0/pass75; each mutant exit1 with 75 real tests, fail>0 and zero cancelled/skipped. Source parser/setup errors and timeouts do not count as kills.
reproduction.originalTwelveGuards: Separate unchanged suite; this additional eight-mutant set does not replace it.
